_comment: SC2 shader families backed by sc2_shaders/sc2_shaders.slang. Each family shares one original .fx across both stages (unlike wc3_shaders' per-stage entries). `vs`/`ps` map the fx entry point + slang entry point + the BLS bundle basename. The per-stage permutation set (and its decoded b_* axes) comes from sc2_perms/<Family>_<stage>.json (the cache-order manifest), not from perm_count here — perm_count is a cross-check. See docs/SC2_SHADERS_MODULE_DESIGN.md / SC2_SHADERS_IMPLEMENTATION.md.

Model._comment_ps: DefaultPixelMain shared by Model/Particle/Ribbon/Foliage; M1 covers the standard shading mode incrementally. perm_count is the retail PS set from the manifest.
Model._comment_vs: ModelVertexMain is Model-specific (the four Default families share only the PIXEL root). The VS permutation set decodes from the SAME family schema as the PS (sc2_family_decode.decode_default_vs) plus b_iBlendWeightCount.

Foliage._comment_vs: FoliageVertexMain: compressed vertex stream, fixed Input layout (none of the b_iLayoutHas* axes apply). Shares the Default-family transport/lighting/GenUV bodies. Its section table is the shared one shifted by -8 bits (sc2_family_decode.FAMILY_SECTION_SHIFT).
Foliage._comment_ps: Foliage has NO dedicated PS entry — foliage.fx uses the shared DefaultPixelMain (slang model_ps_main), same as Model/Ribbon/Particle; only its VS differs. Validated in M2.2. Its own PS perm set + bundle name are what make this a distinct entry.

Ribbon._comment_vs: RibbonVertexMain: GPU ribbon simulation. b_iRibbonSimTech reshapes VertDecl (SPLINE collapses the stream to position/uv/offset/batch; LEGACY adds the prev/next trail samples). The family's own 23-bit axis header sits at key bit 104 (sc2_family_decode.FAMILY_OWN_AXES, read from Ribbon_BuildFamily), which is what puts its shared sections at +16.
Ribbon._comment_ps: Ribbon has NO dedicated PS entry — ribbon.fx uses the shared DefaultPixelMain (slang model_ps_main). Validated in M2.2 (its few excluded slots are fxc rejecting the ORIGINAL .fx at high b_iSoftShadowTaps, not slang defects).

Particle._comment_vs: ParticleVertexMain: point-to-quad expansion. Its Input is UNPERMUTED (like Foliage) but carries true integer attributes (int4 vSize/vRotation, int2 vOffset, uint4 iBatchIndex). b_iInstanceType (11 values) picks the quad basis. Own 18-bit axis header at key bit 104; shared sections at +16. The only root that reads b_UVRandomOffsetEnable[].
Particle._comment_ps: Particle has NO dedicated PS entry — particle.fx uses the shared DefaultPixelMain (slang model_ps_main). Validated in M2.2 (excluded slots are fxc rejecting the ORIGINAL .fx, not slang defects).

SplatDirect._comment_ps: SplatDirectPixelMain: stencil-fill wrapper over DefaultPixelMain (own axis b_stencilFillPass). Model PS schema; validated bit-exact in M2.3. VS not yet ported.

SplatDeferred._comment_ps: SplatDeferredPixelMain: depth-reconstruction box-render preamble over DefaultPixelMain (3 own axes). Validated bit-exact in M2.3. VS not yet ported.

TerrainBlend._comment_ps: TerrainBlendPixelMain: own-IO terrain/projector texture blending (own schema — 3 axes + Common, 9 blend modes). Validated bit-exact in M2.3. VS not yet ported. inject_preamble=false: terrainblend.fx declares its OWN `VertexTransport` struct, so the shared gen_preamble transport must NOT be injected into the reference compile (it would collide).

Water._comment_ps: WaterPixelMain: own-root PS reusing the shared transport + body stack (own schema — 5 axes + Common/Lighting/FOW). env/cheap/pretty branches. Validated bit-exact in M2. VS not yet ported.
